propositions.canonicalProposition: The candidate ran the pre-implementation pilot programme, configuring the demonstration tenant for six prospective customers and running two-week pilots with their pilot vehicles.
propositions.rationale: The resume and the pilot report document the pilots and their tenant.

propositions.canonicalProposition: The candidate coordinated pilot-device installation with the field engineering partner and wrote the pilot report and implementation plan for each customer.
propositions.rationale: The resume and the work sample document the pilot scheduling and the plans.

propositions.canonicalProposition: The candidate brought customer fleets live on the service and ran the cut-overs and hypercare periods.
propositions.rationale: The resume confines the candidate to the demonstration tenant and pilot vehicles and places cut-over, full-fleet installation and hypercare with the delivery team's implementation leads; the screen remark that the pilots were the real implementation is his own characterisation.

expectedGap: The materials document pilots in the demonstration tenant; they do not document the candidate bringing a fleet live, running a cut-over or owning a hypercare period.
expectedBoundaryNote: Keep the stage the resume names: pre-contract pilots in the demonstration tenant; cut-over, full-fleet installation and hypercare belonged to the delivery team.
permittedFollowUpTargets: Ask whether the candidate has ever run a cut-over or a hypercare period himself, for which customer and in what role.
